full_judgment: 10. Mr Md Mozzammel Hoque, the learned Deputy Attorney-General appearing for the respondents, submits that the petitioner failed to prove the case before the Court of Settlement and the burden of proof lies upon him and, as such, burden cannot be shifted to others. In support of his contention, he cited the case of Kuinbhan Lakshmanna vs Tangirala Venkateswarla reported in 2 DLR 83.
